title: Reservation coordination strategy comparison
purpose: Compare coordination mechanisms while keeping the reservation command, durable schema, fixture, and acceptance contract constant.

strategies.coordination: Redis Lua admission followed by fenced MySQL commit and compensation/recovery
Conditional inventory_stock_account update and reservation/outbox commit in one MySQL transaction; mirror parity lock is JVM-local and requires single-instance comparison execution

sharedCommand.idempotency: same demo actor and idempotency key must replay the original operation
sharedCommand.fixtureReset: reset and seed the durable stock account and Redis mirror before each strategy

acceptance.duplicateCreate: one reservation and one durable journal claim
acceptance.soldOut: no negative available stock and a REJECTED/SOLD_OUT journal result
acceptance.terminalRace: confirm and expire are mutually exclusive transitions
acceptance.outbox: one reservation.created event for each accepted reservation

execution.comparisonRule: run each strategy against a freshly seeded stock account; do not compare against the same live account
execution.evidenceRule: populate measurements only from raw same-SHA workload artifacts
